dashboard_overview.current_issue: Overview exists but competes with ingestion/dev panels and does not behave like author home.
dashboard_overview.recommendation: Convert to story operations dashboard: health cards, chapter status, canonical entities needing review, graph health, next best action.

project_selector.current_issue: Still exposes multiple runtime artifacts and technical project cards; markdown_vault remains visible as peer choice.
project_selector.recommendation: Single default workspace header with compact project switcher. Show markdown_vault only under Dev artifacts drawer.

global_graph.current_issue: SVG force approximation still creates rails, edge density, weak initial composition, and graph-first screen feels tool-like.
global_graph.recommendation: Graph canvas/card with clear mode bar, filters, legend, selected-node dock, no edge labels by default, fit-to-content and stable hub-centered layout.

local_graph.current_issue: Local graph is checkbox state, not a distinct author mode.
local_graph.recommendation: Make local graph a mode tied to selected node: neighborhood depth, related chapters, narrative relationships first, backlinks secondary.

wiki_browser.current_issue: Wiki is serviceable but list/detail still file-browser flavored.
wiki_browser.recommendation: Turn into knowledge browser with kind chips, canonical status, summary preview, backlinks count, and duplicate-redirect hint.

node_detail_panel.current_issue: IA improved but still leaks degree/path/canonicalization metadata early and actions feel tool-like.
node_detail_panel.recommendation: Narrative card first: role, bio, facts, relationships, appearances/evidence, review state, then collapsed provenance/technical.

review_queue.current_issue: Review context exists but reads like audit data and button behavior is unclear.
review_queue.recommendation: Author review queue with grouped decisions, impact copy, confidence/evidence chips, and no raw audit unless expanded.

technical_details_dev_mode.current_issue: Technical details tab still in top nav and visible as primary surface.
technical_details_dev_mode.recommendation: Move Artifacts/System/Frontmatter/paths into explicit Dev mode drawer or secondary tab, disabled by default for author mode.

i18n_copy.current_issue: Dictionary exists but many strings remain English or technical, especially canon/review/compare surfaces.
i18n_copy.recommendation: Define primary-copy inventory and fail tests on untranslated nav, controls, empty states, actions, node detail headings.

future_markdown_editor.current_issue: Read-only state is honest but future edit affordance is not framed as roadmap.
future_markdown_editor.recommendation: Use disabled Edit note / Propose canon patch affordance with clear Coming next copy only where meaningful.

visual_hierarchy.current_issue: Panels have consistent styling but similar weights; primary action and selected context do not dominate.
visual_hierarchy.recommendation: Use 3-layer hierarchy: workspace header, active surface, contextual inspector. Reduce badges and muted technical rows.

spacing_typography.current_issue: Dense badge rows and compact controls make UI feel internal.
spacing_typography.recommendation: Increase card spacing, use readable prose widths in node detail, reserve monospace/code only for dev details.

empty_states.current_issue: Some empty states exist but are generic.
empty_states.recommendation: Author-facing empty states should explain narrative meaning and next action, not internal absence.

cta_clarity.current_issue: Open Review Context/Open in Canon/View in wiki are implementation verbs.
cta_clarity.recommendation: Replace with Review duplicate, See canon entry, Open note preview, or hide when redundant.
